Plastering & partitions

A simpler way to rethink your space.

Create a room, reconfigure a layout or prepare the surfaces. Partitions and plastering help your interior evolve with your needs.

Discuss your building project

The right place for every room.

An interior’s layout changes the way you live in it. We assess partitions, openings and substrates to prepare spaces that work for your everyday life.

  • Partition installation
  • Plastering works
  • Internal wall linings
  • Surface preparation and repairs

The feasibility, scope and conditions of the works will be defined after your project has been assessed.

Before
you begin.

Can an extra room be created?

That depends on the space available, openings, ventilation and existing services. Tell us about your idea so we can explore the possibilities together.

Can the works take place while the home is occupied?

Access and occupancy arrangements are among the points to consider before work begins. Planning needs to account for the rooms involved and the constraints of the site.
